list.title: Basic CLI: Monitoring Processes Effectively
list.subheading: Mastering Process Monitoring and Management in Linux
list.excerpt: Learn how to monitor and manage processes in Linux using basic CLI commands like `ps`, `top`, `kill`, `pkill`, and `killall`. This guide provides a detailed breakdown of process monitoring and termination techniques.
list.author: Paul Serban

list.title: Basic CLI: Mounting and Unmounting Media Devices
list.subheading: A Comprehensive Guide to Mounting and Unmounting Media Devices in Linux
list.excerpt: Learn how to mount and unmount media devices in Linux using the command line. This guide covers essential CLI commands like `mount`, `umount`, `fdisk`, and `mkfs`, providing a hands-on approach to managing storage devices.
list.author: Paul Serban

list.title: Basic CLI: Package Management - A Comprehensive Guide
list.subheading: Mastering CLI-Based Package Management Across Different Systems
list.excerpt: Learn how to manage packages efficiently using CLI tools like `apt`, `dpkg`, `yum`, `snap`, `gem`, `pip`, and `git`. This guide covers installation, removal, updates, and best practices for package management on various Linux distributions and programming environments.
list.author: Paul Serban

list.title: Basic CLI: Services and Process Management
list.excerpt: Learn how to manage system services and processes using the command line. This guide covers essential commands like `systemctl`, `kill`, backgrounding and foregrounding processes, and executing multiple commands efficiently.
list.author: Paul Serban

list.title: Basic CLI: Viewing File Content Effectively
list.subheading: Mastering File Viewing Commands in Linux
list.excerpt: Learn how to efficiently view and manipulate file content using essential Linux CLI commands like `cat`, `more`, `less`, and `sort`. Enhance your workflow with these powerful tools.
list.author: Paul Serban

list.title: How to Fix 'Permission Denied' When Creating or Modifying Files in a Directory
list.subheading: A Practical Guide to Resolving File System Permission Issues in Unix-like Systems
list.excerpt: Encountering the 'Permission denied' error when working with files or directories on Unix-like systems? This quick tutorial walks you through understanding, diagnosing, and fixing permission issues using chown and chmod, helping you regain access and productivity.
list.author: Paul Serban
